title: Most people think they have more time.
paragraphs: Most people think they have more time.

In Jesus’ parable, ten virgins waited for the bridegroom.
All of them expected him.
The others slept through the moment that mattered most.

At midnight the cry rang out:
“Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!” — Matthew 25:6

Half of them had oil.
Half of them didn’t.
And when the door closed… it stayed closed.
A faith that only exists when it’s convenient will not survive the midnight hour.
The question isn’t whether you believe the bridegroom is coming.
Will your lamp still be burning when He arrives?

“Which group do you think represents today’s church more:
the wise virgins or the foolish ones?”
